title: Plank interval practice
note: Two 60-second forearm plank holds with 60 seconds of rest between them. There is no final rest or preparation interval in this 3-minute sequence. Start requests MultiTimer; completion requires your checkbox confirmation. This test does not start Watch workout recording.

items.name: Forearm plank
items.detail: 2 × 60 sec holds · 60 sec rest between holds
items.instructions: Hold 60 sec → rest 60 sec → hold 60 sec, then finish. Keep breathing and maintain a comfortable, controlled position. Check the card after completing both holds.
